name: Zamja
summary: In Orgrimmar’s Drag, Zamja teaches Horde travelers to cook. The Darkspear troll shows cooks how to make meals from Kalimdor’s beasts.

sections.title: A Cleaver in the Drag
sections.body: Zamja cuts meat and teaches Horde travelers to cook in the Drag. In Durotar and the Barrens, cooking turns raw game into rations for the rugged road. Cooks who have mastered the basic recipes can seek further training in Gadgetzan, to the south.

faq.answer: Zamja is a Darkspear troll who trains cooks in Orgrimmar’s Drag. She teaches Horde cooks and helps them improve their craft.
You can find Zamja in the Drag, a shaded trench winding between Orgrimmar’s Valley of Strength and Valley of Honor.
Zamja teaches cooking and recipes for preparing food from beasts and game gathered across Kalimdor. Cooks ready for more training can seek advanced instructors.

faq.q: Where does Zamja send advanced cooks?
faq.answer: When a cook outgrows the training in Orgrimmar, Zamja directs them to Gadgetzan in Tanaris to find Dirge Quikcleave.

angles.text: Zamja is one of the main cooking trainers for Horde characters in Orgrimmar. She teaches essential recipes and directs experienced cooks south to Tanaris for advanced instruction.
As a Darkspear troll, Zamja has settled in Orgrimmar beneath Warchief Thrall’s banner. She brings troll resourcefulness and culinary craft to the Horde capital.
